races.verdict: A big-field handicap and a case can be made for several, but GIVEHERTILXMAS has been in fine form at Roscommon and gets the vote to open her account under Colin Keane. Blues Emperor is on a dangerous mark and can back up his latest effort, with Moyassr taken to see out the places. Naoi and Phoenix Pairc are others to consider. races.verdict: This looks wide open and it could pay to side with BELLA COLOMBIA to build on the promise of her unlucky-in-running Leopardstown ninth and bag a fourth success of the season. The reliable Hugo's Girl heads the list of dangers on the back of a breakthrough Laytown victory, although the Joseph O'Brien-trained pair Never The Same and Mai Dahlia look to have more to offer and can also play a part. BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE) HUGO'S GIRL (IRE) NEVER THE SAME (IRE)

races.verdict: DRAGON OF MALTA recorded back-to-back wins at this course 12 months ago having looked on the way back from a slipping mark in recent starts, Pat O'Donnell's 9-y-o gets the nod over Royal Bones , who has shown plenty of promise in maidens and comes from family particularly effective with cut in ground. Resurgence , Amplitude and Great Mover are just a handful of others worth considering, too. DRAGON OF MALTA (IRE) ROYAL BONES (IRE) RESURGENCE (IRE)
